title: Data and code for: Diffusion Language Models and Unified Multimodal Generation: A Critical Systematic Review of Discrete and Continuous Approaches
description: Protocol, search log with every query and export checksum, screening records of two model screeners and the adjudicator, extraction records and validator reports for the stratified sample, decision ledger, analysis scripts, figure and table scripts, and LaTeX sources of a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of diffusion language models and unified multimodal diffusion models (ACM Computing Surveys submission). Full texts of the reviewed papers and raw database exports are not included; abstracts are removed from the bibliographic records.
